log: note '4x1 RAM: W writes D into word A1 A0; @OUT shows the addressed word 32 ticks after the address changes'
label A1 0 1 -6 'address bit 1: wire, driven from the north'
label A0 4 1 -6 'address bit 0: wire, driven from the north'
label W 8 1 -6 'write: wire, driven from the north'
label D 10 1 -6 'data: wire, driven from the north'
label OUT 15 3 35 'output: the addressed word (repeater facing south)'
group ram4 0 1 -6 15 3 36 in @A1 A1 in @A0 A0 in @W W in @D D out @OUT OUT
target new store 'write 1, 0, 1, 1 into words 0..3 (W 20 ticks each), then read 0, 1, 2, 3 every 60 ticks from 200: OUT 1, 0, 1, 1, 32 ticks after each address'
target new switch 'words 0 and 3 hold 1, word 1 holds 0: address 0 -> 3 -> 0 keeps OUT on (no dip), -> 1 turns it off 32 ticks later'
target new sample 'D is sampled 2 ticks after W falls: word 0, W 10..29 with D on; D off at 32 is stored (0), D off at 33 in word 1 is not (1)'
target new address_late 'failure case: the address changes while W is on. 1 tick before W falls is still safe (only word 0 is written); 2 ticks before, word 1 is written too'
target new short 'a 1-tick W writes nothing (the not-W torch ignores it); 2 ticks write'
target new overwrite 'word 0 <- 1 (W 10..29), word 2 <- 1 (W 50..69), word 2 <- 0 (W 90..109): word 2 is 1 from 76 to 115, then 0; word 0 keeps its 1'

A1.note: address bit 1: wire, driven from the north

A0.note: address bit 0: wire, driven from the north

W.note: write: wire, driven from the north

D.note: data: wire, driven from the north

OUT.note: output: the addressed word (repeater facing south)
